description: Push instead of polling ($0.50): buys a 7-day pack of up to 200 webhook deliveries to your public HTTPS URL, signed with HMAC-SHA256. Events: decision_change (hourly decision flips), unusual_flow, funding_extreme (Hyperliquid), news (materiality filter), token_risk_change (up to 5 watched tokens), sec_filing (new SEC filings of your US tickers; needs symbols, filter with forms). Returns the subscription id and its secret (shown once).

categories.description: News categories for news events; omit for all

events.description: Event types to receive: decision_change, unusual_flow, funding_extreme, news, token_risk_change, stablecoin_depeg, sec_filing

forms.description: For sec_filing: only these forms (default all)

url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives the POSTs
